notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata collection omits the preview image.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but there is no separate note field.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs create additional bookmarks without detection or edit guidance.
REF-BM-10: Tags are fixed selection buttons; there is no tag-entry autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, domain, description, and tags, but not notes or the complete URL.
REF-BM-14: The #tag query syntax is not parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesized groups are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase searches are not implemented.
REF-BM-17: There is no unread/read-later state.
REF-BM-18: There is no unread-only view.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk action support.
REF-BM-21: There is no action applying to all bookmarks in the current filtered scope.
REF-BM-23: No markdown note storage or rendering is implemented.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are not implemented.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-29: Saved reusable filter bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: The Settings control is inert and no personal display settings are implemented.
